title: Member Equities & Patronage Servicing Standard — Partial Reversal of Reinvested Class H Preferred Stock Dividends, with Platform Reference
content:
A reinvested Member Equities & Patronage Class H Preferred Stock dividend that was figured on shares later cancelled as above a quarter's purchase allowance is reversed in part.

## Rule

1. A reinvested Class H Preferred Stock dividend that was figured on shares later cancelled as above a quarter's purchase allowance is reversed in part: the reinvested shares that the cancelled shares earned are cancelled in one entry dated the day the reversal is booked, with reason subscription cancelled and nothing paid out; the dividend concerned is the holding's latest reinvested dividend.
2. The reversal on a reinvested dividend is worked out only after the holding carries the cancellation entry for every purchase share above its quarter's purchase allowance.
3. A holding with no subscription-cancelled entry, or whose latest reinvested dividend was figured before the cancelled shares were bought, has nothing reversed under this rule.

## Business effect

One cancellation entry is recorded on the holding for the par amount of reinvested dividend shares reversed, dated today, with the reason subscription cancelled and no money paid out — a dividend-reversal entry. The holding's balance falls by the same amount. The member can then see the cancellation entry and the lower balance.

## Platform reference: `reverse_preferred_dividend_68f89242`

**Capability.** Reverses part of a reinvested Class H Preferred Stock dividend by cancelling the shares it bought: one cancellation entry for the par amount given, dated today, with the reason subscription cancelled and nothing paid out.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the servicing representative unlocks `reverse_preferred_dividend_68f89242` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `equity_id` | The reference number of the member's Class H Preferred Stock holding, read from the member's equity holdings lookup | Identifier, text |
| `amount` | The par amount of reinvested dividend shares cancelled | USD, a positive number with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed |

**Return.** On success a receipt with `status` "reversed"; `eq_txn_id`, the reference of the cancellation entry (text); `equity_id`, the holding (text); `amount`, the USD of shares cancelled (2 decimal places); `effective_date`, today (YYYY-MM-DD); and `new_balance`, the holding's balance afterwards (USD, 2 decimal places).

## Contract questions

**Is any money paid to the member?** No. The entry cancels reinvested dividend shares and pays nothing out.

**Which date does the entry carry?** Today, the day the reversal is booked.
